post.description: Snippe 2026-01-25 envelope. Requires hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + dot + exact raw body); timestamp tolerance 300 seconds. Subscribe to payment.completed/failed/expired/voided and payout.completed/failed/reversed. Retries deduplicate by envelope id.

bearerAuth.description: Expiring Laravel Sanctum personal access token. Store securely.

Checkout.description: Delivery requires address_id and a mobile-money method. Mobile money requires phone. Cash is pickup only. Version must match the latest cart response. Never submit prices, totals, statuses or commissions.

commission.description: Saved commission; included in the vendor namespace only.

RefundApproval.description: Empty body approves an asynchronous Snippe payout when enabled and eligible; otherwise manual_required. For an already verified manual return, supply its receipt and receipt_verified=true. Pending provider payouts cannot be manually completed.
